scope: Small curated refusal regression set for an empty approved corpus, with a deterministic BMI non-refusal control; not a representative user benchmark.
instructions: After source approval and corpus review, add representative queries under cases. expected_chunk_ids must list relevant approved chunk IDs. Set expect_refusal=true only when the approved corpus should not support an answer. refusal_cases are an empty-corpus-only regression set; the evaluator skips them when approved documents are indexed, so replace them with current corpus-specific labels before measuring refusal accuracy against a reviewed corpus.

refusal_cases.query: What is type 2 diabetes and what are common symptoms?
Các yếu tố nguy cơ nào làm tăng khả năng mắc đái tháo đường típ 2?
Glucose 145 mg/dL lúc đói, kết quả này có ý nghĩa gì?
